TITLE: Burnham and Streeting enter race to end Starmer's Labour leadership
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-16 Saturday evening
SOURCE: Channel 4 News

KEY POINTS:
- Burnham went on manoeuvres in Makerfield Saturday, called Makerfield "arguably the most important by-election" in recent memory
- Burnham used Channel 4 News interview to call for UK to go down a "completely" different path to past 40 years
- "Margaret Thatcher deregulated the whole country. The country gave away its control of the basic things that people depend upon every day. And that was a big mistake, in my view."
- Burnham allies told Telegraph he stood by his stance of wanting to rejoin the EU in due course, would require fresh mandate from voters
- Asked on ITV News Saturday whether in favour of rejoining EU: "in the long term there is a case for that" but downplayed it ahead of Makerfield campaign — "not advocating that in this by-election"
- Streeting on Saturday entered race, says will run in any contest
